svg.title: Screen 1 — load the catalog, choose a product, add it to the cart

g.text: Screen 1 — load the catalog, choose a product, add it to the cart
Requirement 1 — the catalog arrives on page load
Two flat queries stitched in memory
and avoids a cartesian result set.
Requirement 2 — pick a category, then a product, then a quantity
until a category is chosen — the
disabling states it without an error.
Requirement 3 — add to cart, reflected on screen
they cannot drift from the items.
